name: change-practice
description: Single, multi-persona organisational change management practice — setup interview, change definition, stakeholder and impact analysis, change risks, sponsor health check, strategy and measurement plan, sponsor and stakeholder engagement, champion network, communications (draft-never-send), training needs, business readiness and go/no-go review, resistance, go-live transition, portfolio saturation, adoption, reinforcement, BAU handover, lessons learned, weekly status, meeting prep and stakeholder pulse. Five personas over one shared change record in docs/change/. People change only — not IT change control.

interface.shortDescription: Plan people change end to end
interface.longDescription: For change managers helping people adopt a new system, process, structure or policy. It covers the work from defining the change through stakeholders, impacts, communications, training, readiness, go-live and adoption, and keeps one shared record the team builds on. Every plan and message is a draft for you to review. Nothing is sent to employees, leaders or customers. IT change control — requests, advisory boards and release approvals — is out of scope.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand a change we are about to make.
Draft an employee update I can review before it is sent.
